title: Harmony Harness: Multi-Objective Self-Evolution of Agent Harnesses
abstract: arXiv:2610.15150v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent work on self-evolving LLM agents treats the agent harness as an optimization target that can be iteratively improved through execution feedback. Existing approaches, however, largely optimize a single objective and evolve the harness as a monolithic artifact, limiting their ability to handle competing goals and to separate transferable design from environment-specific adaptation. We introduce Harmony Harness, a framework for multi-objective, compositional harness evolution. Harmony Harness formulates harness evolution as a multi-objective optimization problem and uses decomposition-based evolutionary search to maintain solutions across different regions of the Pareto frontier, avoiding reliance on a hand-designed structural diversity metric for repository-scale harnesses. translated_title: Harmony Harness：智能体框架的多目标自进化
translated_abstract: 近期关于自进化LLM智能体的研究将智能体框架（agent harness）视为一种可以通过执行反馈进行迭代改进的优化目标。然而，现有方法大多只优化单一目标，并将框架作为一个整体进行进化，这限制了它们处理相互冲突目标的能力，也无法将可迁移的通用设计与环境特定的适配区分开来。我们提出了Harmony Harness，一个用于多目标、组合式框架进化的框架。Harmony Harness将框架进化表述为一个多目标优化问题，并使用基于分解的进化搜索来维护帕累托前沿不同区域的解，从而避免了对仓库规模框架的手工设计结构多样性指标的依赖。与此同时，我们引入了因子化的进化算子，将通用框架机制与基准特定的适配分开进行精炼优化，……
tldr: Harmony Harness提出了一个多目标、组合式的智能体框架自进化框架，通过基于分解的进化搜索在帕累托前沿上维护多样化的解，并利用因子化进化算子将通用框架机制与基准特定适配分离优化。
en_tdlr: Harmony Harness introduces a multi-objective, compositional framework for self-evolving agent harnesses, using decomposition-based evolutionary search to maintain solutions across the Pareto frontier and factorized evolution operators to separately refine general-purpose harness mechanisms from benchmark-specific adaptations.
